_comment: Voice-controllable switches. 'aliases' are what you say. Zigbee devices go through Zigbee2MQTT: set 'zigbee_name' to the friendly name shown in Zigbee2MQTT (run: python -m brain.devices.switch_controller --discover) and 'state_key' to the gang (state, state_l1, state_l2, ...). Other optional keys: command_topic, state_topic, payload_on, payload_off, payload_toggle, gpio_pin, active_high.
